ns2:section.sectionText: Students will learn videography, editing, writing, and producing video content for student programs Good Morning Illini and Illini Sports Night. Class will also include studio production jobs for Good Morning Illini’s live Friday broadcasts and taped studio segments for Illini Sports Night. There are no pre-requisites for this course. Meets with JOUR 317 (71403) and JOUR 417 (71404). Please note: JOUR 217 is repeatable once. However, JOUR 199 TVP TV Prod: Good Morning Illini (SP 64995 or FA 51646) is equivalent to this course. Students can only receive credit twice for any combination of JOUR 217 and JOUR 199 TVP. This section will have distributed attendance. You will receive an email from your instructor with specific attendance directives. Richmond 103, 109, and 110 may all be used for this course to maintain physical distancing guidelines.
